drafted_from: tool row in tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/tool-rows.json, do-work/readback_packaging_intake.py and the fixture of test/test_channel_intake_append_new.py (run to observe)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that the two videos I just added under ch-example-videos are in my packaging ledger with the right titles, thumbnails and caption evidence, against the copy I kept as BEFORE.jsonl." It reads the tool's row and runs readback_packaging_intake.py on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no Trillion list: the ledger is a JSON Lines file in the person's own working folder, one row per video, and the tool reads and writes files there.
instructions: 1. Before adding a batch, copy the ledger (for example to BEFORE.jsonl); add the batch with tool:add-reviewed-videos-to-a-packaging-ledger.

2. Say which batch to check. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: tool:check-a-packaging-intake-against-the-ledger} and runs its `run` command with absolute paths inside your root (add --update-existing when the batch filled in rows that were unreviewed).
3. Read the last JSON line: rows, evidence_references_resolved and output; the report at --output lists each video's resolved identities. A failed check stops with an assertion naming it.
4. When every video resolved and the other rows are unchanged, build the template source (tool:project-a-packaging-ledger-into-template-source).

worked_examples.title: Check a two-video batch against the ledger
worked_examples.ask: Check that the two videos I just added under ch-example-videos are in my packaging ledger.
worked_examples.given: I ran readback_packaging_intake.py on the fixture of tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/test/test_channel_intake_append_new.py after its append-new run (read from do-work/readback_packaging_intake.py). Command: python3 -I tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/do-work/readback_packaging_intake.py --root /work/example-channel --intake /work/example-channel/admission/batch/INTAKE.json --channel-catalog /work/example-channel/admission/batch/CATALOG.json --review /work/example-channel/admission/batch/REVIEW.json --source-key ch-example-videos --ledger /work/example-channel/VIDEO-PACKAGING.jsonl --before-ledger /work/example-channel/BEFORE.jsonl --output /work/example-channel/READ.json. BEFORE.jsonl holds the 4 rows from before the batch.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"rows": 2, "evidence_references_resolved": true, "output": "/work/example-channel/READ.json"} The report READ.json (schema youtube-packaging-intake-consumer-readback@1) has video_ids new-video-1 and new-video-2, ledger_row_count 6, and for each video its title (Title 0, Title 1), its metadata file and thumbnail identity, the thumbnail words ["TEXT"], one opening caption event reference and resolved_reference_count 6.
